title: Special Rate — a typed rate below 1 is stored as a fraction, not a percent (0.5 → 50%)
requirementSource: NM-4022 — TestRail C107718: 0.5 is read as half a percent (0.005000), like every other typed rate (C107717: 2 → 0.020000)
stepsToReproduce: Open Tax → Special Rate for office 1606 (/navigator/locations/1606/taxes/special-rate) on e2e.
On the Rental row tick Special and type 0.5 in the rate box, then leave it.
actualBehavior: The box shows 0.500000 (50%), while 2 → 0.020000 and 1.25 → 0.012500 are read as percent.

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full run and the isolated rerun.
